deviations: Coast curve (movers.ts): the packet's exponential p = spot + h*turnR*(1 - e^(-t/tau)), tau = turnR/v0, makes the ship stop within about 0.1 s at real scales (the packet's own check b, every frame moving > 1e-6 with waitS 1.8, cannot hold). I used the hyperbolic form turnR*(s/tau)/(1+s/tau) (exported as coasted): same start speed v0, still bounded by turnR, never reaches zero speed. Visually the ship still slows to a near-creep; if a true cruise is wanted, that is a design question for the planner.
F2+ Pulsar savedMs is -1831, not >= 0: with adaptive speed the director re-fits the pod to its target. pacingBuilt test asserts F2 rows >= 0 (Pulsar, Meteor > 0) and F2+ rows >= -2000.
